text: A student collected leaves from three varieties of the same species of a garden plant that
Variety C green and white striped leaves
The student made a chloroplast extract from the leaves of each variety and measured the
rate of photosynthesis for each extract in different wavelengths of light.
1 place 10 g of leaves in a mortar with an ice cold phosphate buffer solution
place the mortar in an ice bath and crush the leaves using a pestle
filter the extract through a fine mesh into a small beaker as quickly as possible
completely cover the beaker with metal foil and place in an ice bath.
add 1 cm of methylene blue to each chloroplast extract
re-cover the extracts and keep in an ice bath
collect samples of each extract in capillary tubes and keep covered with metal foil
